---
name: Documentation issue
about: Report missing, unclear, or incorrect documentation
title: "[docs] "
labels: documentation
assignees: ""
---

## Location

Where is the doc? (README path, website URL, inline comment, CLI `--help` output)

## Problem

What is wrong or missing?

- [ ] Missing documentation
- [ ] Incorrect / outdated
- [ ] Unclear wording
- [ ] Broken link
- [ ] Example does not work

## Suggested fix

If you know what the doc should say, describe or paste a draft.

## Audience

Who needs this doc? (new contributor, agent operator, self-hosted user, integrator)

## Additional context

Screenshots, version, or related issues.
